verdicts.why: In Ascension, Fitz and May infiltrate the stolen Zephyr; Giyera knocks May out, Fitz kills him with the Cloaked Gun, frees Daisy and takes the dizzy May with them.
In Maveth, Coulson comes through the portal and shoots It off Fitz; Fitz watches Coulson kill Ward and the two return through the portal together.
In Many Heads, One Tale, May asks for Campbell on extraction; on the Quinjet she apologizes for Lash's killings and he thanks her for shooting Lash when she did.
In Brand New Day, on the Quinjet Daisy tells Mack the team is her family, he assures her they will keep in touch, and later he warns Sousa not to break her heart.

In Stolen, Gordon teleports Jiaying into the meeting Mack assembled; Mack, Coulson, Yo-Yo and Gordon take the Quinjet to Afterlife and Mack takes an I.C.E.R. from Gordon. The show treats young Gordon as Gordon.
In The End Is at Hand, Mack docks with the Zephyr inside the Chronicom ship and holds off the Hunters until Simmons and Deke get back aboard, then blasts them out.
In The End Is at Hand, the whole team, Mack included, regroups at Krazy Kanoe when Simmons's ring opens the Quantum Realm portal and Fitz drops in.
In What We're Fighting For, Mack, May, Coulson and Daisy blow into the Chronicom ship; Mack brings in the unconscious Kora and May sends the empathy signal that stops the Hunters.
In What We're Fighting For, Mack and Coulson board the Chronicom ship together; a year later Mack asks if Coulson got his package, the key to an upgraded flying L.O.L.A.
In The End Is at Hand, Daisy reaches Deke and Simmons on the Chronicom ship, Deke embraces her, and they make it back to the Zephyr.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
value.text: When Yo-Yo loses her powers, Daisy tells her that Jiaying at Afterlife may know how to help, and Yo-Yo goes to find her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman Daisy points to Jiaying for help with her powers.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The friend who points Elena to Jiaying for help with her powers.

verdicts.why: Daisy does tell the team (Yo-Yo there) that Jiaying at Afterlife may help, but it is Mack who sends May and Yo-Yo; the card lines say Daisy sends her, so they now say she points her there.
In Stolen, Gordon teleports Jiaying into the Lighthouse during the team meeting where Daisy explains Malick's power theft, and Gordon offers to take Coulson in. Young Gordon is treated as Gordon.
In The End Is at Hand, Daisy reaches Simmons on the Chronicom ship; Simmons does not seem to remember her, but they convince her to leave and get back to the Zephyr.
In The End Is at Hand, Daisy and the rest of the team are at Krazy Kanoe when the Quantum Realm portal opens and Fitz drops in, reuniting with the team.
In Stolen, Daisy confronts May for not telling her about her sister, and May warns her that Kora already tried to kill Jiaying.
In As I Have Always Been, Daisy learns Coulson has been in the loop longer, and together they remove Simmons's implant, which leads to the fix that ends the loop.

The show treats both as those people (Davis's mind is restored into the LMD, which Piper and Yo-Yo treat as Davis; the recreated Flint keeps his memories), so they do appear, but Mack never shares a scene with the Davis LMD (he is on a Helicarrier), so Mack|Davis gets no stage. Other Davis or Flint pairs need a real exchange (Yo-Yo and Piper with Davis in the car; May, Fitz and Simmons with Flint).
In A Trout in the Milk, Deke and Yo-Yo confront Wilfred Malick in 1976 and Deke kills him.
In The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D, the Zephyr reappears, May and Yo-Yo reunite with Mack and Deke, and Deke recounts the past year to May.
In The Totally Excellent Adventures of Mack and the D, Deke has saved Coulson's mind and introduces him on a TV and VCR, saying Coulson was fine with his recruits being in the Lighthouse.
In Out of the Past, Simmons and Yo-Yo work out together that May now feels the emotions of the people she touches.
In What We're Fighting For, Yo-Yo speed punches Chronicoms to clear the way into the Lighthouse for herself, Fitz, Simmons and Sousa, then guards them while Fitz works.
In The End Is at Hand, Coulson distracts Garrett while Yo-Yo puts the device on him; she rushes the bombs to one spot and finds Coulson shielding May in the rubble.
In As I Have Always Been, Coulson works out that Enoch is programmed to protect the implant; Enoch rips out his mechanism to fix the drive, and Coulson and Daisy stay with him as he dies.
In After, Before, Nathaniel takes over Afterlife and young Gordon teleports Jiaying, May and Yo-Yo out, then teleports away with Jiaying.
In Stolen, Garrett teleports in and grabs Simmons, then he and Nathaniel steal the Zephyr with her aboard.
In Out of the Past, May shares Simmons's excitement when she touches her arm, and Simmons and Yo-Yo work out that May feels the emotions of those she touches.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
value.text: In 1983, Jiaying comes to the Lighthouse asking for help against Nathaniel, and Coulson volunteers to go into Afterlife to free her people while she agrees to stay behind.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Goes into Afterlife to free Jiaying's people in 1983.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Afterlife's leader, whom Coulson helps against Nathaniel.

verdicts.why: They do deal with each other in Stolen (Coulson volunteers to go in, Jiaying agrees to stay and asks them to bring back her daughter), but Mack assembles and leads the team there, not Coulson, so "Coulson's team" and "Leads the team" are wrong.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
value.text: May helps trap Garrett at the Lighthouse and insists on saving him after the blast. When he is shot, she tells the shooter he was a double agent.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Traps Garrett, then insists they save him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A traitor May traps and then saves.

verdicts.why: The events are right, but the card lines are swapped: the line on Garrett's card describes Garrett and the line on May's card describes May.
In The End Is at Hand, Coulson distracts Garrett so Yo-Yo can block his teleporting, tells him it is not too late to switch sides, and Garrett teleports them to the speakeasy where he is shot.
In The End Is at Hand, Hand, startled by the teleporting group at Krazy Kanoe, shoots Garrett in the head as he draws his weapon.
In What We're Fighting For, Fitz explains they can use the Quantum Realm to go back, and Coulson stops him, saying they cannot leave the Chronicoms to take over this timeline.
In The End Is at Hand, Hand fears she killed one of their own and May assures her Garrett was a double agent.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
value.text: When Coulson's group teleports into the speakeasy, Hand shoots Garrett and her fellow agents hold them at gunpoint until Coulson explains they are S.H.I.E.L.D. too.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Coulson convinces that his team is S.H.I.E.L.D. too.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Explains to Hand's group that his team is S.H.I.E.L.D.

verdicts.why: The agents at the speakeasy are led by Brandon Gamble, not Hand, and her group standing by while the team enacts its plan happens in What We're Fighting For (S7#13), later than this S7#12 stage. Corrected to what happens between them at S7#12.

The show treats these 1983 people as the same people, younger: Daisy mourns Jiaying as her mother and Kora is her sister, Coulson and May recognize Garrett, who has seen his own future with Coulson, young Gordon is Jiaying's teleporter, and Hand is named on screen as Victoria Hand of S.H.I.E.L.D. Under the owner's rule their stages go on the main ties; each pair is judged on its own item.
